$sources: EN 1991-1-7:2006 Annex D (informative) Sec D.2, Eqs D.1-D.2: internal natural gas explosions in rooms

sources.explosion: EN 1991-1-7 Annex D, Eqs D.1 pd = 3 + pstat and D.2 pd = 3 + pstat/2 + 0.04/(Av/V)², the larger, valid for 0.05 ≤ Av/V ≤ 0.15 1/m, V ≤ 1000 m³; the points are the two equations for pstat = 3.0 kN/m² (the venting panels' failure pressure, which the project should confirm: override flood.explosion for another pstat); minPressure = Eq D.1. The rise and decay times stay those of the pack it extends. The flood, surge, rain, helipad and shelter rules are not in the Eurocodes covered here: they stay those of the pack it extends (bnbc2020)
